entries.09962dc5405a50e7: Its strengths are a group of proprietary patented methods that achieve decarbonized dismantling ahead of the rest of the world, including the 'Apple Peeling Method,' which greatly reduces high-altitude work in dismantling spherical storage tanks; the 'Windmill Toppling Method,' which calculates the toppling axis to safely topple structures; and the remote-controlled cutting robot 'Ringo☆Star.' In addition to extensive know-how in removing hazardous substances such as PCB, asbestos and dioxins, the company seeks to improve safety and estimation accuracy by strengthening preliminary surveys through its 3D measurement service.
entries.17e2cd0ad9c226b8: Hazardous substance removal work for ＰＣＢ, asbestos and dioxin, etc., and contaminated soil improvement work
entries.23bf21b8690e2efc: Plant dismantling work (dismantling of plants in steel, electric power, gas and oil, etc., and of general buildings)
entries.3464401bc057b25e: For dismantling and maintenance work on all plants, including steelworks, power stations and oil refining facilities, and general buildings such as condominiums and high-rise buildings, the company provides engineering services including construction method proposals, design, supervision, construction management, safety management and administrative response. The company handles removal of hazardous substances such as PCB, asbestos and dioxins, and contaminated soil improvement, using patented methods such as the “Apple Peeling Method” and “Windmill Toppling Method”; construction is outsourced to specialized subcontractors. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥10,818 million.
entries.34d5cccbc19f44f8: Carries out asbestos and dioxin countermeasure work and interior dismantling work. A consolidated subsidiary located in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo (ownership of voting rights 100.0%), which has collaboration and sales cooperation with the company and concurrent officers.
entries.3bac9aa9c5b6c0e3: In the fiscal year ended January 2026, the final year of the 'Decarbonization Action Plan 2025,' large-scale construction projects progressed steadily in the second half, offsetting a temporary slowdown in the first half, and revenue reached a record high of ¥11,140 million. Through improvements to its estimating system, the company promoted selective order-taking of construction projects with high gross margins, and through ingenuity in methods and schedule management worked to improve profitability; as a result, net income attributable to owners of the parent increased to ¥732 million.
entries.53d6be932df33bf3: Customers are mainly large companies that own plants in the steel, electric power, gas and oil industries, among others, as project owners, and the most common arrangement is one in which a facilities construction company in their group or a major general contractor acts as prime contractor and the company acts as subcontractor. In some cases, the company acts as the prime contractor.
